turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've got one empty bed in the backyard and I can't decide what to plant.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Listen to all of them first, then comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first idea is tomatoes and peppers, which need a lot of sun and regular watering.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's a herb garden with basil, mint and rosemary, small and easy to keep up.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is wildflowers for the bees, basically no work once they're in the ground.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's all I've got. Which would you choose?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: How much time do you want to spend out there each week? If you love being in the garden, go for the tomatoes. If not, herbs give you something useful without much work, just keep the mint in a pot or it'll take over.
